Text 4: 在路上 (On the way)
你喜欢吃鱼吗？ (Nǐ xǐhuan chī yú ma?) - Do you like eating fish?
还可以。 (Hái kěyǐ.) - It's okay.
你喜欢喝咖啡吗？ (Nǐ xǐhuan hē kāfēi ma?) - Do you like drinking coffee?
不喜欢，咖啡有点儿苦。 (Bù xǐhuan, kāfēi yǒudiǎnr kǔ.) - I don't like it; coffee is a bit bitter.
你觉得这件衣服漂亮吗？ (Nǐ juéde zhè jiàn yīfu piàoliang ma?) - Do you think this piece of clothing is pretty?
非常漂亮。 (Fēicháng piàoliang.) - Very pretty.
你喜欢写汉字吗？ (Nǐ xǐhuan xiě Hànzì ma?) - Do you like writing Chinese characters?
还可以。 (Hái kěyǐ.) - It's okay.

中国人无论在家还是在饭馆，多人聚餐时一般会坐圆形餐桌，这样大家都可以面对面。 (Zhōngguórén wúlùn zài jiā háishi zài fànguǎn, duō rén jùcān shí yìbān huì zuò yuánxíng cānzhuō, zhèyàng dàjiā dōu kěyǐ miànduìmiàn.) - Chinese people prefer round tables when dining, no matter at home or in a restaurant, so that all can sit face-to-face.

在饭馆里入座的时候，主人的右手边是主客，左手边是次重要的客人。 (Zài fànguǎn li rùzuò de shíhou, zhǔrén de yòushǒu biān shì zhǔkè, zuǒshǒu biān shì cì zhòngyào de kèrén.) - Seated in a restaurant, the host has the main guest on his right hand and the second-most important guest on his left.
主人对面上菜的位置一般不能给客人坐。 (Zhǔrén duìmiàn shàng cài de wèizhi yìbān bù néng gěi kèrén zuò.) - The seat opposite to the host, where dishes are served, usually cannot be offered to a guest.
通过餐桌上的菜也可以分辨主客。 (Tōngguò cānzhuō shang de cài yě kěyǐ fēnbiàn zhǔkè.) - One can tell the host from the guest through the dishes also.

如果有鱼，鱼头要对着最主要的客人，表示主人对客人的尊重。 (Rúguǒ yǒu yú, yú tóu yào duìzhe zuì zhǔyào de kèrén, biǎoshì zhǔrén duì kèrén de zūnzhòng.) - If there is a fish dish on the table, the head of the fish should point to the most important guest to show the host's respect for the guest.
你知道小王今天什么时候来学校吗？ (Nǐ zhīdào Xiǎo Wáng jīntiān shénme shíhou lái xuéxiào ma?) - Do you know when Xiao Wang will come to school today?
他已经来了。 (Tā yǐjīng lái le.) - He is already here.
你怎么知道他来了？ (Nǐ zěnme zhīdào tā lái le?) - How do you know?
我在门外看见他的自行车了。 (Wǒ zài mén wài kànjiàn tā de zìxíngchē le.) - I saw his bike outside the door.
今天的羊肉很好吃，你怎么不吃了？ (Jīntiān de yángròu hěn hǎochī, nǐ zěnme bù chī le?) - The mutton today is excellent. Why don't you eat more?
这个星期天天都吃羊肉，不想吃了。 (Zhège xīngqī tiāntiān dōu chī yángròu, bù xiǎng chī le.) - I eat mutton every day this week. I don't want to eat it any more.
那你还想吃什么？ (Nà nǐ hái xiǎng chī shénme?) - What would you like then?
来一点儿面条吧。 (Lái yìdiǎnr miàntiáo ba.) - Some noodles please.
昨天你们怎么都没去打篮球？ (Zuótiān nǐmen zěnme dōu méi qù dǎ lánqiú?) - Why didn't you guys go to play basketball yesterday?
因为昨天下雨，所以我们都没去。 (Yīnwèi zuótiān xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen dōu méi qù.) - Because it rained yesterday, we didn't go.
我去游泳了。 (Wǒ qù yóu yǒng le.) - I went swimming.
你经常游泳吗？ (Nǐ jīngcháng yóu yǒng ma?) - Do you often swim?
这个月我天天游泳，我现在七十公斤了。 (Zhège yuè wǒ tiāntiān yóu yǒng, wǒ xiànzài qīshí gōngjīn le.) - I swim every day this month. I weigh 70 kilograms now.
这两天怎么没看见小张？ (Zhè liǎng tiān zěnme méi kànjiàn Xiǎo Zhāng?) - I haven't seen Xiao Zhang for days. What's going on?
他去北京了。 (Tā qù Běijīng le.) - He has gone to Beijing.
去北京了？ (Qù Běijīng le?) - Gone to Beijing?
是去旅游吗？ (Shì qù lǚyóu ma?) - Is it for traveling?
不是，听说是去看他姐姐。 (Bú shì, tīngshuō shì qù kàn tā jiějie.) - No. Visiting his elder sister, as far as I've heard.
你怎么不高兴？ (Nǐ zěnme bù gāoxìng?) - Why are you unhappy?
今天怎么这么热？ (Jīntiān zěnme zhème rè?) - Why is it so hot today?
昨天你们怎么都没去打篮球？ (Zuótiān nǐmen zěnme dōu méi qù dǎ lánqiú?) - Why didn't you guys go to play basketball yesterday?
同学们个个都很高兴。 (Tóngxuémen gègè dōu hěn gāoxìng.) - The classmates are all very happy.
这个商店的衣服件件都很漂亮。 (Zhège shāngdiàn de yīfu jiànjiàn dōu hěn piàoliang.) - Every piece of clothing in this shop is very pretty.
这个星期（我）天天都吃羊肉。 (Zhège xīngqī (wǒ) tiāntiān dōu chī yángròu.) - I eat mutton every day this week.
因为她生病了，所以没去学校。 (Yīnwèi tā shēngbìng le, suǒyǐ méi qù xuéxiào.) - Because she was ill, she didn't go to school.
因为他每天跑步，所以身体很好。 (Yīnwèi tā měi tiān pǎobù, suǒyǐ shēntǐ hěn hǎo.) - Because he jogs every day, he is in good health.
因为昨天下雨，所以我们都没去（打篮球）。 (Yīnwèi zuótiān xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen dōu méi qù (dǎ lánqiú).) - Because it rained yesterday, none of us went (to play basketball).
小王今天来学校了吗？ (Xiǎo Wáng jīntiān lái xuéxiào le ma?) - Did Xiao Wang come to school today?
他看见小王了没有？ (Tā kànjiàn Xiǎo Wáng le méiyǒu?) - Did he see Xiao Wang?
为什么他今天不想吃羊肉？ (Wèi shénme tā jīntiān bù xiǎng chī yángròu?) - Why doesn't he want to eat mutton today?
为什么昨天他们都没去打篮球？ (Wèi shénme zuótiān tāmen dōu méi qù dǎ lánqiú?) - Why didn't they go to play basketball yesterday?
小张为什么去北京？ (Xiǎo Zhāng wèi shénme qù Běijīng?) - Why did Xiao Zhang go to Beijing?
谁在房间学习汉语呢？ (Shéi zài fángjiān xuéxí Hànyǔ ne?) - Who is studying Chinese in the room?
他在房间学习汉语呢。 (Tā zài fángjiān xuéxí Hànyǔ ne.) - He is studying Chinese in the room (stress on 在).
他在哪儿学习汉语呢？ (Tā zài nǎr xuéxí Hànyǔ ne?) - Where is he studying Chinese?
他在房间学习汉语呢。 (Tā zài fángjiān xuéxí Hànyǔ ne.) - He is studying Chinese in the room (stress on 房间).
是他在房间学习汉语，不是别的人。 (Shì tā zài fángjiān xuéxí Hànyǔ, bú shì bié de rén.) - It is him who is studying Chinese in the room, not other people.
他是在房间学习汉语，不是在别的地方。 (Tā shì zài fángjiān xuéxí Hànyǔ, bú shì zài bié de dìfang.) - He is studying Chinese in the room rather than in other places.
因为天气不好，所以我没去商店。 (Yīnwèi tiānqì bù hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù shāngdiàn.) - Because the weather is bad, I didn't go to the shop.
工作太忙 (Gōngzuò tài máng) - Work is too busy. (exercise clause for 因为……，所以……)
不能去跑步 (Bù néng qù pǎobù) - Cannot go jogging. (exercise clause for 因为……，所以……)
汉字太难了 (Hànzì tài nán le) - Chinese characters are too difficult. (exercise clause for 因为……，所以……)

下雨了 (Xià yǔ le) - It is raining. (exercise clause for 因为……，所以……)
不能去旅游 (Bù néng qù lǚyóu) - Cannot go traveling. (exercise clause for 因为……，所以……)

你怎么不吃了？ (Nǐ zěnme bù chī le?) - Why don't you eat anymore?
我吃好了。 (Wǒ chīhǎo le.) - I'm full.
考试没考好。 (Kǎoshì méi kǎohǎo.) - I didn't do well in the exam.
大卫回来了吗？ (Dàwèi huílai le ma?) - Is David back?
没有，他还在教室学习呢。 (Méiyǒu, tā hái zài jiàoshì xuéxí ne.) - No. He is still studying in the classroom.
已经9点多了，他怎么还在学习？ (Yǐjīng jiǔ diǎn duō le, tā zěnme hái zài xuéxí?) - It's after 9 o'clock. Why is he still studying?
明天有考试，他说今天要好好准备。 (Míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, tā shuō jīntiān yào hǎohāo zhǔnbèi.) - There will be a test tomorrow. He said he'll work hard in preparation for it today.
你现在在哪儿呢？ (Nǐ xiànzài zài nǎr ne?) - Where are you now?
在去机场的路上。 (Zài qù jīchǎng de lùshang.) - I'm on the way to the airport.
你已经到了吗？ (Nǐ yǐjīng dàole ma?) - Have you arrived?
我下飞机了。 (Wǒ xià fēijī le.) - I've got off the plane.
你还有多长时间能到这儿？ (Nǐ hái yǒu duō cháng shíjiān néng dào zhèr?) - How many more minutes do you need to get here?
二十分钟就到。 (Èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.) - In 20 minutes.
你家离公司远吗？ (Nǐ jiā lí gōngsī yuǎn ma?) - Do you live far from your company?
很远，坐公共汽车要一个多小时呢！ (Hěn yuǎn, zuò gōnggòng qìchē yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí ne!) - Yes, very far. It takes more than one hour by bus.
坐公共汽车太慢了，你怎么不开车？ (Zuò gōnggòng qìchē tài màn le, nǐ zěnme bù kāi chē?) - Buses are slow. Why don't you drive?
开车也不快，路上车太多了！ (Kāi chē yě bú kuài, lùshang chē tài duō le!) - It's not fast either. There are too many cars on the road.
今天晚上我们一起吃饭吧，给你过生日。 (Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ chī fàn ba, gěi nǐ guò shēngrì.) - Let's have dinner together tonight to celebrate your birthday.
今天？离我的生日还有一个多星期呢！ (Jīntiān? Lí wǒ de shēngrì hái yǒu yí ge duō xīngqī ne!) - Tonight? My birthday is more than one week later.
下个星期我要去北京，今天过吧。 (Xià ge xīngqī wǒ yào qù Běijīng, jīntiān guò ba.) - Next week I'll go to Beijing. Let's celebrate it today.
好吧，离这儿不远有一个中国饭馆，走几分钟就到了。 (Hǎo ba, lí zhèr bù yuǎn yǒu yí ge Zhōngguó fànguǎn, zǒu jǐ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.) - Fine. There's a Chinese restaurant nearby, only a few minutes' walk away.
八点了，他还在睡觉。 (Bā diǎn le, tā hái zài shuìjiào.) - It's eight o'clock and he is still sleeping.
你怎么还没吃饭？ (Nǐ zěnme hái méi chī fàn?) - Why haven't you eaten yet?
他还在教室学习呢。 (Tā hái zài jiàoshì xuéxí ne.) - He is still studying in the classroom.
同学们七点半就来教室了。 (Tóngxuémen qī diǎn bàn jiù lái jiàoshì le.) - The classmates were already in the classroom by half past seven.
我坐飞机一个半小时就到北京了。 (Wǒ zuò fēijī yí ge bàn xiǎoshí jiù dào Běijīng le.) - It takes me only an hour and a half to get to Beijing by plane.
二十分钟就到。 (Èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.) - In 20 minutes.
我家离学校很远。 (Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn yuǎn.) - My home is far from the school.
学校离机场有20多公里。 (Xuéxiào lí jīchǎng yǒu èrshí duō gōnglǐ.) - The school is more than 20 kilometers from the airport.
离我的生日还有一个多星期呢！ (Lí wǒ de shēngrì hái yǒu yí ge duō xīngqī ne!) - My birthday is still more than a week away!
八点上课，时间还早呢。 (Bā diǎn shàng kè, shíjiān hái zǎo ne.) - Class starts at eight; it is still early.
医院离我们这儿还远呢。 (Yīyuàn lí wǒmen zhèr hái yuǎn ne.) - The hospital is still far from here.
坐公共汽车要一个多小时呢！ (Zuò gōnggòng qìchē yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí ne!) - It takes more than one hour by bus!
大卫在哪儿学习呢？ (Dàwèi zài nǎr xuéxí ne?) - Where is David studying?
九点多了，大卫为什么还不休息？ (Jiǔ diǎn duō le, Dàwèi wèi shénme hái bù xiūxi?) - It's after nine; why is David still not resting?
坐公共汽车一个小时能到公司吗？ (Zuò gōnggòng qìchē yí ge xiǎoshí néng dào gōngsī ma?) - Can one get to the company in an hour by bus?
公司离家很远，她为什么不开车？ (Gōngsī lí jiā hěn yuǎn, tā wèi shénme bù kāi chē?) - The company is far from home; why doesn't she drive?
今天不是她的生日，为什么她朋友要今天给她过生日？ (Jīntiān bú shì tā de shēngrì, wèi shénme tā péngyou yào jīntiān gěi tā guò shēngrì?) - Today is not her birthday; why does her friend want to celebrate her birthday today?
他姓张？ (Tā xìng Zhāng?) - Is his surname Zhang? (rising intonation, question)
他姓张。 (Tā xìng Zhāng.) - His surname is Zhang. (falling intonation, statement)
他不喜欢喝啤酒？ (Tā bù xǐhuan hē píjiǔ?) - Doesn't he like drinking beer? (rising intonation, question)
他不喜欢喝啤酒。 (Tā bù xǐhuan hē píjiǔ.) - He doesn't like drinking beer. (falling intonation, statement)
机场离我家非常远，我坐出租车去机场。 (Jīchǎng lí wǒ jiā fēicháng yuǎn, wǒ zuò chūzūchē qù jīchǎng.) - The airport is very far from my home; I take a taxi to the airport.
我的生日是2月22号。 (Wǒ de shēngrì shì èr yuè èrshí'èr hào.) - My birthday is on February 22.
生日的时候，我常和朋友去吃饭。 (Shēngrì de shíhou, wǒ cháng hé péngyou qù chī fàn.) - On my birthday, I often go out to eat with friends.
我们下午去看电影，好吗？ (Wǒmen xiàwǔ qù kàn diànyǐng, hǎo ma?) - Let's go to see a movie this afternoon, shall we?
今天下午我没有时间，明天下午再去吧。 (Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān, míngtiān xiàwǔ zài qù ba.) - I'm not free this afternoon. Let's go tomorrow afternoon.
你想看什么电影？ (Nǐ xiǎng kàn shénme diànyǐng?) - Which movie would you like to see?
让我想想再告诉你。 (Ràng wǒ xiǎngxiang zài gàosu nǐ.) - Let me think about it and I'll tell you later.
外边天气很好，我们出去运动运动吧！ (Wàibian tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen chūqu yùndòng yùndòng ba!) - It's a nice day outside. Let's go out to do some exercise.
你等等我，好吗？ (Nǐ děngdeng wǒ, hǎo ma?) - Please wait for me for a minute, will you?
王老师让我给大卫打个电话。 (Wáng lǎoshī ràng wǒ gěi Dàwèi dǎ ge diànhuà.) - Professor Wang asked me to give David a call.
回来再打吧。 (Huílai zài dǎ ba.) - Call him after we come back.
找大卫有什么事情吗？ (Zhǎo Dàwèi yǒu shénme shìqing ma?) - What's the matter?
听说大卫病了，我想找时间去看看他。 (Tīngshuō Dàwèi bìng le, wǒ xiǎng zhǎo shíjiān qù kànkan tā.) - I heard that David is sick. I want to visit him sometime.
